query.description: Start date to search a past date range. Leave blank to search prior day transactions. If you enter a date, you must also specify an end date. Start date can not be older than 180 days from today. If no date range is provided, the request returns the prior weekday's information. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

End date for a date range. Leave blank to search prior day transactions. If you enter a date, you must also specify a start date. The end date cannot be today's date. To search for a single day's transactions, make the end date the same as the start date. If no date range is provided, the request returns the prior weekday's information. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
